  
Optotax  Product Documentations  
India’s  No:1 GST Filing Platform.

**What is Optotax?**  
Optotax is a India No:1 GST filing software for CA’s, Tax Practitioners, Advocates, Articles and others which is absolutely free of cost for Tax Professionals. Optotax is an easy to use software that automates the process of filing GST returns. It saves a lot of time and effort by providing automated calculations and filing. It also provides real-time updates and alerts to ensure accuracy.

**When it started ?**

**Ans.**The service Optotax was launched in 2018 for filing GST monthly and quarterly returns, and Open financial technologies acquired it in January 2021\. The Optotax application is regularly updated and improved so that it can provide the best possible experience for users.

**How to use Optotax?**  

**Ans.**Optotax is very easy to use. All you need is an internet connection and a computer. You can start using it immediately with a few clicks.

**Common issues in GST needing speeder resolution.**

* Mis-match between ITC appearing in GST R2A v. GST R3B  
* Mismatch between ITC appearing in books of accounts v. GST R2A  
* ITC denial on account of Supplier’s default  
* GST law prescribes a ‘last date’ to avail ITC; If not availed, ITC lapses  
* Difference in Sales Turnover reported in GST R1 v. GST R3B.


  
**A need for simplification**

* All GST returns with ARN’s not appearing at one place on GST Portal  
* Simplified process of filing from one login credentials for all your clients  
* Downloading all GST Returns in one click  
* A beautiful dashboard displaying all clients at one place  
* Client information and client management not available at one common place

  **  ![][image1]**

**Optotax is a management tool for all GST compliances & GST filings of all your clients.**

* URL link \- gst.optotax.com,  
* Login to the portal can be made using Gmail ID or any other ID,  
* Four conditions to be fulfilled if we are not using Gmail ID (ex-Name@123),  
* Optotax needs only basic details of the User \- These are not your client details,  
* GSTIN details of the user is not mandatory.

Adding a client has two  options: You can either add them manually or import them from a CSV file. Once you have added your clients, you can start filing for your clients**.**

   Click on the button:- Download the excel for Bulk Clients.

**Start GST Returns Filing From Optotax**

Filing of GSTR 1, GSTR 3B & GST R9 is made simple by Optotax and involves three step procedure

1. Import data using  any of the three methods  
* Government notified excel  
* Excel generated from tally  
* Json file  
1. Save to GSTN  
2. Submit the Return  
3. All returns can be filed directly from Optotax.  There is no need to sign in GSTN portal at all  
4. Option to file GSTR 3B through auto-computed values from GSTR1

**GST: In Optotax three types of return filings are available.**

1. GST R1   
2. GST R-3B  
3. GST R9  
   

**Q. What is GST R-1? Who is required to file GST R-1?**   
 **Ans.**GSTR-1 is a monthly/quarterly Statement of Outward Supplies to be furnished by all normal and casual registered taxpayers making outward supplies of goods and services or both and contains details of outward supplies of goods and services.

Note:Due date to file **GST R1 11th date every month.**

**Q. What is GST R3B?**   
**Ans.**GSTR-3B is a monthly/quarterly return with the summarized details of sales, purchases, sales during the month along with the amount of GST liability. This return is auto-generated pulling information from GST R1.

Note:Due date to file **GST R3B 20th date every month.**  
	  
**Q.What is Form GST R9?**   
**Ans.** GST R9 is an annual return to be filed once for each financial year, by the registered taxpayers who were regular taxpayers, including SEZ units and SEZ developers. The taxpayers are required to furnish details of purchases, sales, input tax credit or refund claimed or demand created etc.

Note:Due date to file **GST R9 31st date December.**

**Steps to  File GST R1 Return in Optotax.**  
**![][image6]**										

* Select the client,  
    
* Download the excel file and import,  
    
* Data is being added to save in  the GST Portal,  
    
* Click on the submit button and view the summary;  
    
* Click on the EVC or DSC,  
    
* Generate the OTP and file the returns.  
    
    
  




**Steps to  File GST R3B Returns in Optotax.**

* Select the client ,  
    
* click on GST tab,  
    
* Import the excel or add the details manually,  
    
* → All the figures 3.1 TAX ON OUTWARD AND REVERSE CHARGE INWARD SUPPLIES will be populated automatically once the GST R1,  
    
* →Click on proceed to offset,  
    
* →Click on submit,  
    
* →File the returns**.**

**Additional Benefits and  Features**

* Automatic Purchase reconciliation from books of accounts with GSTR-2A,  
* GSTR 2A-Party wise, Rate wise \- (Monthly / Quarterly / Yearly),  
* GSTR 2A and GSTR 3B reconciliation (Monthly / Quarterly / Yearly),  
* GSTR-1 and GSTR 3B reconciliation (Monthly / Quarterly / Yearly),  
* GSTR 3B & GST R1 Summary or detailed download along with ARNs for full \- or part of the year.  
* Downloading ITC ledger for the full year.  
* Beautiful Dashboard displaying all ARNs for all clients.  
* File GST Returns of all clients from a single login ID.
